<infobox theme="Media">
    <image source="image"></image>
    <title source="title"></title>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Publication information</header>
        <data source="format"><label>Format</label></data>
        <data source="production"><label>Production</label></data>
        <data source="network"><label>Network(s)</label></data>
        <data source="published in"><label>Published in</label></data>
        <data source="release date"><label>Release date</label></data>	
        <data source="runtime"><label>Run time</label></data>
    </group>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Attribution information</header>
        <data source="director"><label>Director(s)</label></data>
        <data source="producer"><label>Producer(s)</label></data>
        <data source="writer"><label>Writer(s)</label></data>
    </group>
	<navigation><small>{{PlainLink|//starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Template:Documentary|name=<nowiki>[</nowiki>Source<nowiki>]</nowiki>}}</small></navigation>
</infobox>{{PreloadCat}}<!-- TEMPLATE ENDS HERE.
